|title=Out of Thin Air

==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
[[Rand]] is in [[Far Madding]], intent on killing his enemies. He has caught sight of [[Manel Rochaid]] and is following him. Rand recalls that [[Raolin Darksbane]] was born in the city; [[Yurian Stonebow]] was born some time later. [[Lews Therin]] rages in Rand's head that they are both fools to have traveled to Far Madding, as neither men nor women can channel the [[One Power|Power]] while in the city. Rand smiles grimly as he thinks, ''They [his enemies] were fools.'' He left discreet suggestions and hints in the [[Stone of Tear]], the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] in [[Chachin]], and other famous places, that led to Far Madding. Thinking they were on his trail, the gullible [[Asha'man]] immediately went to the city. As Rand follows Rochaid, he stumbles into an [[Aiel]]man who is, as apparent from his cloths and behavior, following the [[Way of the Leaf]]. Lews Therin whispers that Rand has destroyed them, and also comments, "''How many will we three kill before the end, I wonder''." {{ref|Who is [[Lews Therin]] talking about when he says, "How many will we three kill before the end, I wonder"? The answer is [[Rand]], himself, and [[Moridin]]}} Rochaid turns into a narrow alleyway, so narrow that the only way to proceed is in single file. Rand follows him, and walks into the trap. Rochaid tries to attack him, but Rand, using Aiels'  bare-hand martial arts, breaks his windpipe. [[Raefar Kisman]] is on one of the low roofs, and leaps down with a sword as Rand is on top of Rochaid. Perhaps sensing something is wrong, or because of his ''[[ta'veren]]'' luck, Rand rolls away from the weak body, and Kisman, too late, plunges his sword into a surprised Rochaid. They both hear the Street Guards approaching, and Kisman tells Rand that if they are found, both of them will be executed, so they agree to call a truce. Kisman runs one way, Rand the other. He is sure that the Far Madding [[Counsel]]s would not harm the [[Dragon Reborn]], but would definitely hand him over to the [[White Tower]] as they have accepted [[Elaida]]'s amnesty.

:{{pov|[[Raefar Kisman]]}}
[[Raefar Kisman|Kisman]] is furious with [[Manel Rochaid|Rochaid]]. The latter was supposed to have waited for everyone to arrive, but he had wanted ultimate glory in killing the [[Dragon Reborn]]. The only thing that he had gotten was death. Kisman, he tells himself, wants power, not glory. He recalls how the [[M'Hael]] was furious when he ordered his attack on Rand in [[Cairhien]] and discovered that they had been revealed and their plan failed. He had given specific orders that [[Far Madding]] would be their last chance. Suddenly, [[Dashiva]] had vanished. [[Demandred]] had then ordered them to kill Rand, and not let the [[M'Hael]] know of it. [[Moridin]] had told them to kill Rand as a last resort, but to bring his possessions to him. {{ref|Moridin wants Rand's belongings so he can have the access keys to the [[Choedan Kal]], therefore preventing Rand from cleansing ''[[saidin]]''}} Kisman is brought back from his world of thoughts when he feels pain through a sudden slash on his arm. {{ref|[[Padan Fain]] slashes [[Raefar Kisman|Kisman]] with the [[ruby dagger]]}} The wound is black, and feels like it is burning. Kisman tries to run, to go to safety, but it is too late. Blackness approaches, and he falls.

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
[[Rand]] returns to the inn he is staying in. He tells [[Lan]], who is in the common rooms, what happened, and gathers [[Nynaeve]], [[Alivia]], and [[Min]] to his room. There, he tells them to pack as lightly as possible. They are leaving. He sits down to draw pictures of the four rogue [[Asha'man]], and finds that his pictures look life-like. He was never good at drawing. However, [[Lews Therin]] was. That fact should have bothered him. ''Should'' have. But it didn't.

:{{pov|[[Slayer]]}}
[[Slayer]] steps out of ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' and finds himself in a bedroom of an inn, remembering one of his previous missions:  killing the [[Black Ajah]] sisters [[Amico Nagoyin]] and [[Joiya Byir]],{{Ref/book|4|12}} who were being held in the [[Stone of Tear]] and expected him to break them free, and that he enjoyed the killing. He becomes [[Luc]]. There are two figures on the bed, and he promptly stabs them with his poisoned daggers. He likes to see who he kills, as a general rule, so he turns them over, and is disappointed that they are not who he was expecting (i.e. Rand, his nephew,  and Min). He returns to ''Tel'aran'rhiod'' and meets his employer. He can see nothing of the employer except that he is a man. Slayer believes that the man must be one of the [[Chosen]], as they are one of the special few who know how and where to find him. His employer tells him to wait for more instructions. Slayer agrees, and [[Travel]]s to another place. The only thing he likes more than murdering people is killing wolves. He turns into [[Isam]] and begins the hunt.
